map.输入角速度 ω，求周期 T。: Input angular velocity ω to find period T.
map.📖 查看「由角速度求旋转周期 使用指南」: 📖 View "Rotation Period from Angular Velocity Guide"
map.成转一圈所需的周期。: to the period required for one turn.
map.T = 2π/6.283 = 1 s。即角速度 6.283 rad/s 时每圈: T = 2π/6.283 = 1 s. That is, when angular velocity is 6.283 rad/s, 1 s per turn.
map.T=2π/ω=6.28318/1.5708=4.0000 s，即每 4 秒完成一: T=2π/ω=6.28318/1.5708=4.0000 s, i.e. one turn completed every 4 s.
map.T=1/f；周期 1 秒即频率 1 Hz，两者一致。: T=1/f; period 1 s equals frequency 1 Hz, consistent.
map.周期和频率有什么关系？: What is the relationship between period and frequency?
map.互为倒数：T=1/f。本例 T=4.0000 s 对应 f=0.25 Hz。注意: Reciprocal: T=1/f. In this example T=4.0000 s corresponds to f=0.25 Hz. Note ω cannot be 0 — angular velocity 0 means no rotation, period tends to infinity, the tool will give a meaningless result.
